method_selection.citation: ablation-study methodology (standard practice); ESMM multi-task aux framing (Ma et al., SIGIR 2018); duration-bias line (D2Q KDD 2022, CWM KDD 2024).
method_selection.why: Validation peaks around epochs 6-8 and then declines while training loss continues downward, indicating overfit. A tuned package champion already exists, so the prescribed next move is an add-on combination sweep rather than repeating the package or closing with another seed ensemble. Testing duration-regime heads and recency variants, including promising pairs, on the regularized champion can expose interactions and has a more honest chance of exceeding the 0.002 convergence threshold than any single near-noise-floor add-on.

rejected.reason: Already used successfully on this dataset; repeating it would violate the preference against retried openings and provide limited new evidence.
It largely revisits architecture, loss, recency, and regularization choices already bundled in the accepted champion, at very high runtime.
The run already used a five-seed ensemble, and ensembling is a closing move; with 13 iterations left, single-model interaction search has higher information value.

expected_delta_basis: The selected combo-sweep card estimates individual add-ons at +0.0008 to +0.0015 and specifically recommends testing their pairs on an accepted tuned package to determine whether complementary mechanisms compound beyond the 0.002 noise threshold.

+class DCNLite(nn.Module):

+def build_pairs(users, labels, seed):
